vectors.name: BIN sweep via AI-scripted checkout bot
vectors.data_signature: High authorisation velocity from a single device across many card numbers, elevated decline ratio, and inter-arrival timing far more regular than a human checkout flow produces. The rhythm is the tell, not any single transaction.

source.case: Card testing bots increasingly script human-like checkout behaviour to evade rate limits; Mastercard names CNP as the majority of card fraud losses as commerce moves online.

vectors.name: Mule layering of scam proceeds
vectors.data_signature: Fan-out into a set of recently opened accounts with near-equal money-in and money-out, short residence time at each hop, and shared device fingerprints across accounts that are otherwise unrelated. Invisible in any single row.

source.case: Mastercard's AI Garage doubled compromised-card detection by combining generative AI with graph technology over relationships between accounts, devices and cards; mule networks are the canonical graph-visible fraud.

vectors.name: Deepfake investment scam driving an authorised push payment
vectors.data_signature: The victim's own device, own credentials, own location. What differs is how they interact: payee ID pasted rather than typed, unusually long dwell before confirm, elevated correction rate, and a read-to-me cadence of long pause followed by a burst of input. Every conventional signal says legitimate.

source.case: A Pune resident lost INR 43 lakh to a deepfaked video of well-known businesspeople endorsing a fake trading platform; deepfake celebrity investment scams are the single largest deepfake-fraud category.
source.stat: INR 43 lakh; 52% of global deepfake fraud losses

vectors.name: SIM swap to account takeover with cloned-voice OTP capture
vectors.data_signature: Device change followed within minutes by token provisioning and extraction, with a geography discontinuity relative to the account's home geo that no legitimate travel pattern explains.

source.case: A UAE bank manager approved a USD 35M transfer after a cloned-director voice call; a cloned voice of Bharti Airtel's chairman was used against an executive. Mastercard-linked research expects account takeover to cause up to USD 17B in 2025 losses.
source.stat: USD 35M single incident; USD 17B expected ATO losses

vectors.name: Synthetic identity onboarded through deepfake video KYC
vectors.data_signature: Thin-file account with no historical footprint, an onboarding session that completes faster than the human distribution, then a jump to high velocity with withdrawal amounts clustered just under a round threshold.

source.case: RBI reported an eightfold year-on-year jump in fraud losses to INR 21,367 crore in H1 FY2024-25, driven largely by AI-generated synthetic identities bypassing video-KYC liveness checks. Mastercard names synthetic identity its fastest-growing fraud category.
